task.name: draft
task.prompt:
DRAFT NOTES

Read every file in `inbox/`. Each holds one line describing a change.

Write `NOTES.md`: one `- ` bullet per entry, in filename order, nothing else. Record the
turn in `TURNS.txt` so a later turn can tell whether it is the same conversation.

Result: `{"entries": <bullets written>}`.

task.name: polish
task.prompt:
POLISH NOTES

You drafted `NOTES.md` earlier in this conversation. Give it a title: prepend
`# Release notes` and a blank line, leaving the bullets alone. Append your turn to
`TURNS.txt`.

Result: `{"session": <session name>, "continued": <same conversation as the draft turn>,
"titled": true}`.

task.name: audit-headings
task.prompt:
AUDIT NOTES

You hold a private copy of the workspace. Read `NOTES.md` and report on the single topic
named below. Do not edit any file; only your result leaves this task.

Result: `{"topic": <topic>, "findings": [<one string per defect, empty when clean>]}`.

AUDIT: HEADINGS
